parsed.post: The last experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.1 and 5% warmup regressed slightly (1.0965 vs 1.0954). It seems the learning rate might be slightly too high for this specific configuration or the warmup is insufficient. I'll try reducing the learning rate to 0.08 and increasing warmup to 10% to stabilize.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to ensure stable convergence.
